purpose: Unapproved pricing hypotheses; conditional unit economics, not a sales prediction or spending authorization.

price.source: One-time scenario maintenance pack price to interview after use; not listed or sold

platform_share.source: https://www.agensi.io/terms sections 6.4 and 7.1; recheck before launch; use only if MIT/delivery issue resolved

creator_tool_per_order.source: Allocated creator support-model cost, not actual invoice

creator_tool_per_active.source: Allocated creator trial assistance cost; buyer's own Agent cost is excluded

minutes_per_active.source: Includes non-buying activated trial users; replace from consented pilot logs

minutes_per_order.source: Post-purchase support per order; not measured

minutes_per_refund.source: Refund handling/support, including reversed creator share; not measured

hourly_value.source: Creator time valuation, not wage, budget approval or cash payment

monthly_cash.source: Allocated recurring tools; no service purchased

initial_hours.source: One-time packaging/onboarding investment, included once at each horizon

recruitment_hours_month.source: Time to recruit/observe, not assumed free traffic

zero_30.basis: hypothesis: all funnel values, not platform traffic

base_30.basis: hypothesis: all funnel values, not platform traffic

upside_30.basis: hypothesis: all funnel values, not platform traffic

zero_90.basis: hypothesis: cumulative unique qualified views; not added to 30-day scenario

base_90.basis: hypothesis: cumulative unique qualified views; not added to 30-day scenario

upside_90.basis: hypothesis: cumulative unique qualified views; not added to 30-day scenario

billing_note: CLI token counters are not per-request subscription invoices. No verified monetary inference charge is available; do not convert them to fabricated spend. Payout/currency/network fees and seller taxes require account-specific verification before cashflow decisions.
